operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case table names: "Player_Attributes", "Team", "Team_Attributes" vs backtick-quoted Player/League/Country; identifiers must be double-quoted with original case.
DDL uses backtick quoting and tab-indented columns; CREATE TABLE text must be replayed verbatim for the empty clone.
Player_Attributes is large (183,978 rows) with 43 columns; read_schema must sample by rowid % k, not full scan.
Two FKs from Player_Attributes to Player on player_api_id and player_fifa_api_id; both parents are UNIQUE in Player, so FK fill is well-defined.
Team_Attributes FKs to Team.team_fifa_api_id, but Team.team_fifa_api_id is NOT unique (285 distinct of 299, 3.7% NULL) — FK parent has NULLs and duplicates.

Team_Attributes.team_fifa_api_id has 0 NULLs but its parent Team.team_fifa_api_id has NULLs; FK fill from parent values will inject NULLs into a NOT-NULL-looking column (declared notnull=0 so insert succeeds).
Player.height declared INTEGER but storage class is 'real' (e.g. 182.88) — declared type contradicts storage; Number fuzzer will emit ints, changing semantics of height comparisons.
date/birthday columns are TEXT storing 'YYYY-MM-DD 00:00:00' — declared TEXT dispatches to String fuzzer, not Date; TS will not produce date-shaped values.
attacking_work_rate / defensive_work_rate have dirty values ('None' string, 'le', '_0', '5') mixed with medium/high/low — String fuzzer will treat these as elements.
League.id and Country.id share identical values (1,1729,4769,...) — coincidental, not an FK; do not infer a relationship.
Player_Attributes.id and Team_Attributes.id are AUTOINCREMENT PKs; TS Number fuzzer will generate arbitrary ints, not sequential — fine for insert but breaks 'id ordering' assumptions.
buildUpPlayDribbling has 66.5% NULL — Number fuzzer drops None elements, so TS will rarely emit NULL there despite the original being mostly NULL.
operator_ts_expectations: date/birthday/Team_Attributes.date: String fuzzer with charset a-zA-Z 0-9() and length 0-20 — produces garbage like 'aB3()' instead of 'YYYY-MM-DD'; any query filtering on date ranges or LIKE '2015%' will get implausible values (FN driver).

player_name, team_long_name, team_short_name, League.name, Country.name: String fuzzer with 0.5 contaminate — names become random strings with prefixes/suffixes; joins on name equality still work but DISTINCT/LIKE queries see noise.
preferred_foot (2 distinct: right/left): String fuzzer with p=0.2 will mostly emit fresh random strings, so 'WHERE preferred_foot = "right"' returns few/no rows — FN driver.
attacking_work_rate/defensive_work_rate: String fuzzer mixes the 8/19 dirty originals with random strings; 'WHERE attacking_work_rate = "high"' may return 0 rows — FN driver.
All *_Class columns (buildUpPlaySpeedClass etc., 2-3 distinct): String fuzzer with p=0.2 mostly fresh strings; equality filters on 'Balanced'/'Fast'/'Slow' return few rows — FN driver.

overall_rating/potential and all skill columns (INTEGER, 40-97 distinct, range ~0-100): Number fuzzer with scale=0 draws uniform in [-1,1] then perturbs ±1/±2 — values cluster near 0, so 'WHERE overall_rating > 80' returns 0 rows — FN driver.
height (INTEGER, real storage): Number fuzzer emits ints near 0, not 150-200; 'WHERE height > 180' returns 0 rows — FN driver.

id/player_api_id/player_fifa_api_id/team_api_id/team_fifa_api_id: Number fuzzer with scale=0 draws near 0; FK fill copies parent values so joins work, but 'WHERE player_api_id = 505942' (a literal from train SQL) returns 0 rows unless the literal pool seeded it — FN driver.
League/Country (11 rows each): choose_table_sizes may give 1-30 rows; small tables mean joins on country_id/league_id have few matches — FP driver when gold expects specific counts.

Team_Attributes.team_fifa_api_id FK to non-unique Team.team_fifa_api_id: TS draws with replacement from parent values, so many child rows share the same parent — joins produce duplicate rows; gold queries with DISTINCT or COUNT(DISTINCT) may differ — FP/FN driver.

Team.team_fifa_api_id has NULLs; FK fill copies NULLs into Team_Attributes.team_fifa_api_id (declared notnull=0 so insert OK) — 'WHERE team_fifa_api_id IS NOT NULL' counts differ from original — FP driver.

Player_Attributes has 183,978 rows but choose_table_sizes caps at 2500 (level-based) or ~230 (rand_lin) — TS instances are tiny relative to original; aggregate queries (AVG overall_rating) see different distributions — FP driver.
